P0.oracle_source: data/grixis/m7/wick_rev1/Wick_M7_Rev1_Scryfall_snapshot.json — Wick Oracle ID and trigger/activation text
P0.payable_fixture: Wick {3}{B} in play as a Rat; separate own and opposing Rat ETB events; one existing or absent Snail; four successive Wick triggers with a single Snail present.
P0.positive_assertion: Own Wick/Rat entry while controlled causes one 1/1 Snail when absent, otherwise puts one counter on the existing Snail; four more entries grow a single Snail to power five.
P0.adversarial_assertion: An opponent-controlled Rat does not trigger Wick, and an own Rat entry after Wick leaves no longer creates a Wick-triggered Snail.

P0.oracle_source: data/grixis/m7/wick_rev1/Wick_M7_Rev1_Scryfall_snapshot.json — Wick, Bulk Up, Lich's Relic Oracle
P0.payable_fixture: Pay actual {U}{B}{R} plus sacrifice a controlled Snail as activation cost. Fixture Snail power seven plus Lich's Relic +2, one Bulk Up power-doubling instant, then legal Wick activation and opponent removal of Wick in response.
P0.positive_assertion: Sacrificed Snail last-known power eighteen is snapshotted when paid as cost, generating three 18-damage opponent results and 18 card draws after Wick's activated ability resolves.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Removing Wick in response does not change the paid sacrifice or last-known power; this bounded fixture does not invent Snail return or free source of colored mana.

P0.oracle_source: data/grixis/m7/wick_rev1/Wick_M7_Rev1_Scryfall_snapshot.json — Arcane Adaptation, Leyline of Transformation, Maskwood Nexus, Conspiracy
P0.payable_fixture: Place named actually controlled or applicable type-add enchantment/artifact in play with a creature that began as Snail; choose Rat, without inventing a new entering event.
P0.positive_assertion: Each of Arcane Adaptation, Leyline of Transformation and Maskwood Nexus adds Rat without removing Snail, so a newly entering Snail qualifies for Wick entry and Snail-sacrifice cost.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Conspiracy replaces original creature types, yielding Rat without Snail, so the modeled token cannot satisfy Wick's printed sacrifice-a-Snail cost.

P0.payable_fixture: Pay {B} Tainted Strike on controlled Wick while it is a legal instant target, and separate {U}{B}{R} plus Snail sacrifice to activate its deal-damage ability; model Snail power ten.
P0.positive_assertion: The activated ability explicitly makes Wick deal damage; Wick having infect means ten power can produce ten poison counters for each damaged opponent.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Giving infect to sacrificed Snail alone cannot change the ability's actual Wick damage source; no poison is credited to a noninfect Wick in that alternative.

P0.oracle_source: data/grixis/m7/wick_rev1/Wick_M7_Rev1_Scryfall_snapshot.json — Wick, Cavern of Souls, Phyrexian Altar, land texts
P0.payable_fixture: One Wick activated ability cost {U}{B}{R}; finite sources representing single U, B, R, colorless Swarmyard, restricted Cavern and one Snail consumed by Altar.
P0.positive_assertion: Three independent unrestricted U/B/R sources pay a legal activation; Cavern may produce tribal color for a Rat creature SPELL cast, a distinct payment use.
P0.adversarial_assertion: One Cavern-plus-B-plus-R cannot pay the U in an activated ability; one Altar sacrifice supplies only a single mana, not all three U/B/R pips.

P1.payable_fixture: Pay printed {U}{B}{R} for one Wick activation using exactly U, B and R rather than incorrectly borrowing Cavern's restricted creature-cast color; compare one chosen-Rat creature spell cast.
P1.positive_assertion: Cavern's printed restriction applies to creature spell casting only, so colored mana may correctly cast a Rat creature spell.
P1.adversarial_assertion: The same special tribal-colored mana may not pay Wick's ability; a colorless Cavern activation does not produce the missing blue pip.

P1.payable_fixture: Snail carrying five +1/+1 counters leaves after legitimate sacrifice; The Ozolith in play stores five counters, then begin combat on its controller's turn with a legal target creature.
P1.positive_assertion: Ozolith can receive saved Snail counters on the leave event and can transfer those counters only at its printed beginning-of-combat trigger.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Stored counters are not transferred to a newly created Snail instantaneously in response to a Wick activation before the next combat trigger window.

P1.payable_fixture: Wick alive with four actual own Rat-enter events and four legal Wick trigger resolutions; no invented token entry from simply changing an existing permanent's subtype.
P1.positive_assertion: Four own Rat entry triggers create one Snail initially and then place three counters, reaching one power-four Snail, with no duplicate Snail creation while one is controlled.
P1.adversarial_assertion: An existing Snail merely becoming a Rat via Arcane Adaptation has not entered the battlefield and therefore does not create a free Wick trigger.

P1.payable_fixture: After four real entry triggers, resolve an actual add-Rat type-changer and separately stage a subsequent fresh Rat-entry event, then resolve its Wick trigger.
P1.positive_assertion: A genuinely new Rat entry after changing types grows the already present Snail by one additional counter, reaching power five.
P1.adversarial_assertion: The type-changing continuous effect alone creates zero pending Wick triggers and cannot substitute for a real Rat permanent entering.

P1.oracle_source: data/grixis/m7/wick_rev1/Wick_M7_Rev1_Scryfall_snapshot.json — Wick, Arcane Adaptation, Goblin Bombardment, Altar Oracle
P1.payable_fixture: Controlled Wick, added-Rat Snail, already pending genuine Rat-entry trigger, and zero-mana Snail sacrifice outlet; explicitly pay each sacrifice and resolve each new Wick trigger, bounded to twelve iterations.
P1.positive_assertion: Each sacrifice removes exactly one Snail; ensuing Wick trigger creates a Rat/Snail and one new pending Wick trigger, repeating under a real free outlet and creating twelve replacement tokens/36 Impact Tremors events across three opponents.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Without a type changer only one new Snail appears and the loop ends; removing Wick before a replacement entry prevents additional triggers. Yawgmoth life payment is not misrepresented as free.

P1.payable_fixture: Marrow-Gnawer untapped with one, two, three, or four controlled Rats in play; sacrifice one Rat as activation cost, then count survivors to create corresponding Rat tokens; Intruder Alarm untaps creatures after entries.
P1.positive_assertion: With two Rats, sacrificing one leaves one to create one, sustainable rather than increasing; three Rats leave two and create two, increasing to four, and a fourth Rat increases to six.
P1.adversarial_assertion: With one Rat the cost removes Marrow-Gnawer and no Rats are generated; the symmetric Alarm also untaps opposing creatures, so this is not an isolated free advantage.

P1.payable_fixture: Wick on battlefield with a source-paid {U}{B}{R}/Snail sacrifice ability, Snail power 50, three opponents each at 35 life and 20 cards left in the controller library.
P1.positive_assertion: The ability can deal fifty Wick-source damage to each opponent before mandatory drawing fifty cards; Tainted Strike changes source damage if applied to Wick.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Attempting fifty draws from only twenty cards is not a guaranteed single-player win and may cause the controller to lose through empty-library state-based actions; no unsupported guaranteed survival claim.

P1.payable_fixture: Own Rat has entered and one Wick trigger is pending; opponent removes the existing eight-power Snail before the trigger resolves. Separate branch removes Wick before a later Rat enters.
P1.positive_assertion: If no Snail exists when pending entry trigger resolves, it creates a new 1/1 rather than putting a counter on a departed Snail.
P1.adversarial_assertion: If Wick is removed before the new Rat enters, that later Rat entry generates no Wick trigger; earlier activated abilities on stack do not retroactively disappear.
